# discord_invite (Resource)

Manages a channel invite. Invites cannot be edited, so every change creates a new invite. An invite that expires or is revoked outside Terraform is created again on the next apply. Reading invites requires the Manage Channels permission on the channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_invite" "website" {
  channel_id = discord_text_channel.general.id
  max_age    = 0 # never expires
}

output "invite_url" {
  value = discord_invite.website.url
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel to invite to.

### Optional

- `audit_log_reason` (String) Reason recorded in the server's audit log for changes this resource makes, overriding the provider's `audit_log_reason`. Up to 512 characters. Changing only this argument updates state without calling Discord.
- `max_age` (Number) Seconds until the invite expires, between `0` (never) and `604800` (7 days). Defaults to `86400`.
- `max_uses` (Number) Maximum number of uses between `0` (unlimited) and `100`. Defaults to `0`.
- `temporary` (Boolean) Whether the invite grants temporary membership. Defaults to `false`.
- `unique` (Boolean) Whether to always create a new invite. When `false`, Discord may return an existing invite with the same settings, which other resources could then share. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Invite code.
- `expires_at` (String) When the invite expires (RFC 3339), or null if it never expires.
- `id` (String) Invite code.
- `url` (String) Invite URL, `https://discord.gg/<code>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_invite.website
  identity = {
    channel_id = "123456789012345678"
    code       = "abc123XY"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel.
- `code` (String) Invite code.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_invite.website <channel_id>/<code>
```
